composites.name: network-demo
composites.description: Minimal MEDYAN-style actomyosin network: a handful of seeded actin filaments treadmilling under a Brownian-ratchet boundary force. Emits the core scalar network metrics each step.

interval.description: Process interval in seconds. MedyanProcess subdivides each interval into n_substeps mechanochemical steps.

n_filaments.description: Initial number of seeded actin filaments.

composites.name: network-demo-with-viz
composites.description: MEDYAN-style network demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar network metrics, written to the 'viz_html' store.

n_filaments.description: Initial number of seeded actin filaments.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.
